title: The Legionella collagen-like protein employs a unique binding mechanism for the recognition of host glycosaminoglycans
authors: Saima Rehman; Anna K. Antonovic; Ian E. McIntire; Huaixin Zheng; Leanne Cleaver; Carlton O. Adams; Theo Portlock; Katherine Richardson; Rosie Shaw; Alain Oregioni; Giulia Mastroianni; Sara B-M Whittaker; Geoff Kelly; Arianna Fornili; Nicholas P. Cianciotto; James A. Garnett
one_liner_zh: 该文研究军团菌胶原样蛋白Lcl与宿主糖胺聚糖的识别机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但通过晶体结构和MD模拟解析蛋白-糖类互作界面与动态结合模式，其分子互作建模方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Bacterial adhesion is a fundamental process which enables colonisation of niche environments and is key for infection. However, in Legionella pneumophila , the causative agent of Legionnaires’ disease, these processes are not well understood. The Legionella collagen-like protein (Lcl) is an extracellular peripheral membrane protein that recognises sulphated glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) on the surface of eukaryotic cells, but also stimulates bacterial aggregation in response to divalent cations. Here we report the crystal structure of the Lcl C-terminal domain (Lcl-CTD) and present a model for intact Lcl. Our data reveal that Lcl-CTD forms an unusual dynamic trimer arrangement with a positively charged external surface and a negatively charged solvent exposed internal cavity. Through Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, we show how the GAG chondroitin-4-sulphate associates with the Lcl-CTD surface via unique binding modes. Our findings show that Lcl homologs are present across both the Pseudomonadota and Fibrobacterota-Chlorobiota-Bacteroidota phyla and suggest that Lcl may represent a versatile carbohydrate binding mechanism.
abstract_zh: 细菌粘附是一个基本过程，使微生物能够定殖于特定环境，并且是感染的关键。然而，在军团菌（Legionella pneumophila）——军团病的致病菌——中，这些过程尚未被充分理解。军团菌胶原样蛋白（Lcl）是一种细胞外外周膜蛋白，能够识别真核细胞表面的硫酸化糖胺聚糖（GAGs），同时也能响应二价阳离子刺激细菌聚集。在此，我们报告了Lcl C端结构域（Lcl-CTD）的晶体结构，并提出了完整Lcl的模型。我们的数据揭示，Lcl-CTD形成一种不寻常的动态三聚体排列，具有正电荷的外部表面和负电荷的溶剂暴露内部腔体。通过分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，我们展示了GAG硫酸软骨素-4如何通过独特的结合模式与Lcl-CTD表面关联。我们的发现表明，Lcl同源物存在于变形菌门（Pseudomonadota）和纤维杆菌-绿菌-拟杆菌门（Fibrobacterota-Chlorobiota-Bacteroidota）中，并提示Lcl可能代表一种通用的碳水化合物结合机制。
